q: Low-vision reading goals build in reserve acuity because fluent, accurate reading requires acuity about:
w: Threshold acuity allows only slow spotting. Fluent reading needs roughly 3 lines of reserve, so a device is prescribed to give acuity better than the target print size.
k: Fluent reading needs about 3 lines of acuity reserve.

q: A patient with hemianopsia or a severely constricted visual field is best helped by a:
ans: field expander such as a reverse telescope or prism
w: Field expanders (prisms, mirrors, reverse telescopes, minus lenses) minify the scene so more of it fits within the remaining field. Magnifiers would shrink the field further.
k: Constricted field or hemianopsia = field expander (minify).
